name: China Reinsurance (Group) Corporation
summary: China Reinsurance (Group) Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, operates as a reinsurance company in the People's Republic of China and internationally. The company operates through Property and Casualty Reinsurance, Life and Health Reinsurance, Primary Property and Casualty Insurance, Asset Management, and Other segments. It offers reinsurance products, including motor, commercial and household property, engineering, marine hull, liability, credit and guarantee, health, agriculture, space and aviation, energy, nuclear, etc.; and insurance agency services, such as risk identification, assessment and consulting, insurance program design, insurance procurement, insurance policy manageme…
